class Game:
    def __init__(self, puzzle):
        self.groups = puzzle["groups"]
        self.words = [w for g in self.groups for w in g["words"]]
        self.remaining = list(self.words)
        self.selected = []
        self.mistakes = 0
        self.max_mistakes = 4
        self.solved = []

    def toggle(self, word):
        if word in self.selected:
            self.selected.remove(word)
        elif word in self.remaining and len(self.selected) < 4:
            self.selected.append(word)

    def shuffle(self):
        random.shuffle(self.remaining)

    def deselect_all(self):
        self.selected = []

    def guess(self):
        if len(self.selected) != 4:
            return None
        for i, g in enumerate(self.groups):
            if set(self.selected) == set(g["words"]):
                self.solved.append(i)
                for w in self.selected:
                    self.remaining.remove(w)
                self.selected = []
                return {"correct": True, "group": g, "level": g["level"], "won": len(self.remaining) == 0}
        # wrong: check one-away
        counts = [len(set(self.selected) & set(g["words"])) for g in self.groups]
        self.mistakes += 1
        result = {"correct": False, "one_away": max(counts) == 3, "lost": self.mistakes >= self.max_mistakes}
        if result["lost"]:
            self.selected = []
